# Architecture — nrscholar-frontend (web)

## Layout

```
src/
├── main.tsx               entry: styles, i18n, <App />
├── app/
│   ├── App.tsx            BrowserRouter + all routes, auth/session handling, screen-time tracker
│   ├── components/Layout.tsx
│   └── NotFoundScreen.tsx
├── features/
│   ├── auth/pages/        login, signup steps, forgot password, parental gate
│   ├── dashboard/pages/   child + parent screens (missions, battles, tests, rewards, reports…)
│   └── users/pages/       profile, edit profile, help center
├── components/            shared visuals: DragonCharacter, MonsterCharacter, InteractiveCompanion, LottiePlayer, ChildSwitcherModal
├── shared/assets/Content/ learning content (NCERT by subject/class)
├── api.ts                 apiFetch + auth/session helpers + response caches
├── config.ts              APP_CONFIG (brand)
├── i18n.ts, locales/{en,hi,gu}.json
└── styles/                index.css (Tailwind), App.css
```

## Feature folders

**[Preserve]** Screens live in `src/features/<feature>/pages/<Name>Screen.tsx`.

**[Standard]** As features grow, add siblings next to `pages/` instead of growing screens:

```
src/features/<feature>/
├── pages/        route-level screens only (thin: compose hooks + components)
├── components/   pieces used by this feature's screens
├── hooks/        useX.ts: data fetching and stateful logic
├── api.ts        this feature's endpoint functions (built on apiFetch)
└── types.ts
```

`dashboard/` is overloaded (child and parent screens). New parent-only screens may go in a new `src/features/parent/` folder. Move existing screens only in a dedicated refactor.

## Routing

- All routes are declared in `src/app/App.tsx`. Heavy screens (3D, battles, PDF reader, missions) are `React.lazy`. **New heavy screens must be lazy too.**
- **[Standard]** Route paths used in `navigate()` come from a constants file, not repeated literals.
- Route paths are a **contract with the mobile shell**: `mobile/app/practice/webview.tsx` opens web paths (`/home`, multiplayer, evolution, daily-tip, lessons, challenges, achievements, kids-activity…). Renaming or removing a path needs the `impact-analysis` skill.
- Parent-only screens stay behind the parental gate/role checks already in `App.tsx`.

## State

| State | Today | Standard for new code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Server data | `useState` + `useEffect` + `apiFetch` in screens | A feature hook (`useProgress()`) wrapping the feature's `api.ts`. Screens don't call `apiFetch` directly |
| Session/user | `localStorage` (`userToken`, `refreshToken`, `userData`) + `force-logout` event | Keep it. Read and write through helpers in `src/api.ts`, not ad-hoc `localStorage` calls |
| Cross-screen UI state | Props / `localStorage` | Zustand is installed (used in mobile). Use it for genuinely shared client state instead of `localStorage` or `window` events |
| Local UI | `useState` | `useState` / `useReducer` |

**[Avoid]** New ad-hoc caches in `localStorage` (`api.ts` already caches `/api/users/me` and the parent report and clears them on any mutation), new `window` events for app state, and React Query/Redux without approval.
